# About me

I'm a data scientist and educator with a focus on computational biology.
I work as an Associate Director of Genomics Data Science at LifeEdit, where I
develop genomics data pipelines for laboratory scientists, analyze
experimental data, and lead and support protein engineering and discovery
initiatives.

I also serve as an adjunct faculty instructor at UNC-Chapel Hill, where I teach
data science courses in both the Gillings School of Global Public Health and
the School of Data Science and Society.

You can find my UNC course materials on GitHub:

- [DATA-730 Statistical Modeling and Inference for Data Science](https://github.com/UNC-DATA-730)
- [BIOS-512 Data Science Basics](https://github.com/chuckpr/BIOS512)
